cells.new: ✅ Notify-only update checks (`autoupdate: false` disables); `/update` installs 1.x or offers v2; `opencode upgrade [ver] [--major]`
cells.detail: ✅ — Updates are never installed automatically: the startup check only notifies (`autoupdate: false` disables it; `OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE` and `OPENCODE_ALWAYS_NOTIFY_UPDATE` override). `/update` installs a newer 1.x or offers 2.0, and `opencode upgrade [ver] --major` installs v2 and removes v1.
